_about: Every region (3D shape family) on the whole 3-sphere. A component is one connected volume; components of one orbit are images of each other under the group. 'members' lists the representative component's (copy, piece) pairs; any other component of the orbit is g applied to it (copy k -> multiplication[g, k]). 'boundary' lists that component's faces: each wall, the region across it, and the exact parts (copy, patch) it is made of.
